source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the fixed accepted revision, VirtualFolderWrapper::GetOnlineSearch receives bool* and passes that pointer as int64_t* to FolderDatabase::GetFolderProperty. The called overload writes stmt->AsInt64(0) through its output when a property row exists. The original wrapper landing already has this cast. Preserve the actual pointed-to type when evaluating this path; a cast does not provide int64_t storage for the Boolean output. This is an exact static type/write mismatch and a focused validation gap, not a reproduced overwrite, crash or new runtime result.
title: The Panorama onlineSearch getter passes a Boolean output to an integer writer
